record.paper_title: Open Problems in the Topology of Manifolds
record.original_question: Let q >= 3, let M be a closed connected compact 2q-manifold, let xi_M^{q-1}: B_M^{q-1} -> BO represent the normal (q-1)-type of M, and let S_st(M) be the stable class of M. The Q-form construction induces a map mu/aut(xi) from S_st(M)/L_{2q+1}(Z[pi],w1) to isometry classes of Q_{xi_M^{q-1}}(q)-forms modulo automorphisms of xi_M^{q-1}. Is this map injective; equivalently, for M0 and M1 in S_st(M), does M0 = rho M1 for some rho in L_{2q+1}(Z[pi],w1) hold exactly when M0 and M1 admit normal (q-1)-smoothings to B_M^{q-1} whose Q_{xi_M^{q-1}}(q)-forms are isometric?

evidence.quote: Conjecture B. (The Q-form Conjecture for the stable class) If q >= 3, then the map mu/aut(xi) of (3) is injective

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix an integer $q\ge 3$ and let $M$ be a closed connected compact smooth $2q$-manifold. Let $\xi_M^{q-1}\colon B_M^{q-1}\to BO$ denote the normal $(q-1)$-type of $M$ in the sense of Kreck's modified surgery (so $B_M^{q-1}\to BO$ is a fibration through which the stable normal bundle of $M$ factors via a $(q-1)$-smoothing, i.e.\ a lift which is a $q$-equivalence). Write $\pi=\pi_1(M)$ and $w_1\colon\pi\to\{\pm1\}$ for the orientation character, and let $L_{2q+1}(\mathbb Z[\pi],w_1)$ denote Wall's odd-dimensional surgery $L$-group, which acts on the stable diffeomorphism class
$$\mathcal S^{st}(M)=\{N\colon N\text{ closed }2q\text{-manifold},\ N\#_k(S^q\times S^q)\cong M\#_k(S^q\times S^q)\text{ for some }k\ge 0\}/\!\cong.$$

For any normal $(q-1)$-smoothing $\bar\nu\colon M\to B_M^{q-1}$, Kreck's construction associates a quadratic refinement $Q_{\xi_M^{q-1}}(q)$-form on a $\mathbb Z[\pi]$-module derived from the surgery kernel in degree $q$. Forming the quotient by the action of the automorphism group $\mathrm{aut}(\xi_M^{q-1})$ of the fibration $\xi_M^{q-1}$ and by $L_{2q+1}(\mathbb Z[\pi],w_1)$ yields a well-defined map
$$\mu/\mathrm{aut}(\xi)\colon \mathcal S^{st}(M)/L_{2q+1}(\mathbb Z[\pi],w_1)\;\longrightarrow\;\bigl\{\,Q_{\xi_M^{q-1}}(q)\text{-forms}\,\bigr\}\big/\mathrm{aut}(\xi_M^{q-1}).$$

Question: Is this map injective? Equivalently, given $M_0,M_1\in\mathcal S^{st}(M)$, does there exist $\rho\in L_{2q+1}(\mathbb Z[\pi],w_1)$ with $M_0=\rho\cdot M_1$ if and only if $M_0$ and $M_1$ admit normal $(q-1)$-smoothings to $B_M^{q-1}$ whose associated $Q_{\xi_M^{q-1}}(q)$-forms are isometric?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is stated as a conjecture (the "Q-form conjecture for the stable class") in a recent open-problems collection, and related work by Conway–Crowley–Powell–Sixt on stably diffeomorphic manifolds and the Kreck monoid $l_{2q+1}(\mathbb Z[\pi])$ addresses the structure of stable classes but does not establish injectivity in general. No general proof was found, so the conjecture appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Stably diffeomorphic manifolds and l_{2q+1}(Z[π])
status_evidence.snippet: Inside the stable class involves delicate quadratic algebra starting with Wall's L-groups and Kreck's l-monoids.
status_evidence.claim: Active research on stable classes via Kreck monoids and Q-forms; injectivity of the Q-form map not established in general.

status_evidence.title: Simply connected manifolds with large homotopy stable classes
status_evidence.snippet: Stable classes of 2q-manifolds can be large; classification within them is a subtle open question.
status_evidence.claim: The classification of manifolds within a stable class is an actively studied open problem.
